name: Crystal Clusters

features.name: Exploding clusters
features.description: Gem clusters explode and multipliers rise with each explosion.

review:
Crystal Clusters is a cluster slot on a rectangular grid where glowing gems link up and explode. Multipliers rise with every explosion, so long chain reactions are rewarded.

Three or more scatters start free spins, and each reel can hold only one scatter. Three scatters give 10 free spins, and more scatters give 12, 15, 20 or 30. During the bonus, multipliers are locked in, so later cascades benefit from what has already built up. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 96.5% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 273 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
